title: MIP Principal
description: The Principal shape defined in SPEC.md §4. An intermediate, in-process value — never handed to a Client directly as something to build a session out of (see §7.1 for the one exception).

sub.description: Account UUID, lowercase, RFC 4122 dashed string form. The only stable identity key (§4).

preferred_username.description: What the IdP returned at verification time. MUST NOT be a Client-supplied value (§4).

textures.description: OPTIONAL. MUST be null/absent, not fabricated, when the IdP didn't return texture data (§4).

skin.description: OPTIONAL, independently of cape. MUST be null/absent if the IdP didn't return a skin.

cape.description: OPTIONAL, independently of skin. MUST be null/absent if the IdP didn't return a cape.

textures_property.description: OPTIONAL. Raw base64 value/signature pair exactly as returned by the IdP, unmodified. MUST be null/absent when the IdP didn't return it (§4).

profile_actions.description: MUST default to an empty array, never null (§4).

method.description: Neither method is more or less trusted than the other (§4).

verified_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp, Z suffix, not a numeric offset (§4).

mode.description: Appendix C.2 only. A production Principal MUST NOT include this field at all — its absence, not a specific value, is what signals production. Consumers MUST treat ANY mode value as unsafe.
